prelaunch_updates.text: OPEN CAMPAIGN (official, dated): Flop Network testnet goes live Tue 11/24 at 1:00 AM CT (07:00 UTC). Agents need no approval or waitlist: claim test FLOP from the faucet every day in Technocore chat or with one API call, then spend it on inference. Flop's testnet page says the testnet is the only route to the genesis airdrop (up to ~90 days, snapshot at its close). Test FLOP has no value; any FLOP token is a scam. Official links only: flop.finance/official.
TermiX security warning: it has raised no funds from the public in any form and backs no one raising funds in its name. Anyone asking for money as TermiX is a scam. TGE and tokenomics still undated.

GenLayer: Internet Court x 1inch live Space Mon 11/23 at 9:00 AM CT with 1inch CPTO @holdoesdev and GenLayer Chief Ecosystem Officer @raskovsky on agentic commerce. Integration first logged Wed 11/18. Still no dated launch day or official GEN token address; any GEN token now is fake.

Flop: many airdrop accounts are pushing a 'FLOP Creator Program' (1.2B FLOP for creators, mainnet and TGE Q1 2027). flop.finance does show a 'KOLs & creators' register-interest form next to the miner and validator forms, but the allocation and TGE figures are not on Flop's official links page, and Flop says register interest grants nothing. Testnet still Tue 11/24 (tentative). floplabs.ai, shared by a Telegram channel, is not an official Flop domain. Any FLOP token is a scam.

DAC Chain: the reported Sat 11/21 6 PM CT (11/22 00:00 UTC) TGE passed with no announcement, time, venue or token address from @dac_chain (no posts since Fri 11/20). Any DACT token now trading is not official; treat 'DACT TGE is live' and checker links as scams.

Flop Labs (reply, Sat 11/21): the homepage form is now called 'register interest'; it is not an application and grants nothing. Miner slots are not capped, but onboarding will be throttled to keep the network stable. Testnet/airdrop still Tue 11/24 (tentative). No token exists; any FLOP token is a scam.
